title: unifold manifest
description: A unifold.yaml: the manifest of a unit. See https://unifold.md/spec. Keys marked 'root only' are allowed in the manifest of the project root, which is the one that has the key `unifold`.

unifold.description: Root only, and required there: the version of the standard, as a string.

name.description: Root only. The name of the project. Default: the name of the root folder. Every root manifest should set it, so that generated files do not depend on the folder name.

responsibility.description: What the unit is responsible for, in one sentence. `TODO` marks a draft.

kind.description: Free text. logic, stateful and adapter are well known and carry rules. Required on a unit with children below the root.

status.description: planned: code missing or incomplete. active: the default. deprecated: to be removed.

owner.description: Team or person responsible. Units below inherit it.

secret.description: What the unit hides because it is hard to get right or likely to change.

decision.description: A path, relative to the manifest, to a decision of this unit or of an ancestor that says why this is the secret.

not.description: What the unit does not do. An item is one line, or one line mapped to the need of this unit through which the thing is delegated.

needs.description: The needs, keyed by name. A need says what is required, never who supplies it. The parent wires it, unless this unit meets it inside, in its own wiring.

wiring.description: Connections inside this unit; every connection is written out, there is no wildcard and no connection by equal names. Key: `child.need`, a need of this unit (met by a child), or a capability of this unit (implemented by a child). Value: the provider, or a mapping of named alternatives (the first is the default). A reference is split at its last dot; `child` is a folder name or a path relative to the unit.

scenarios.description: The scenarios this unit holds, keyed by name: one story as the chain of calls it causes.

ignore.description: Root only. Folders, relative to the root, that are not searched for units.

diagrams.description: Root only. parents: diagrams for units that have children. all: also a context diagram for every other unit. none: no diagrams.

diagram-links.description: Root only. How boxes in generated diagrams link: none, relative, or the base URL of the repository's file view.

max-lines.description: Root only. The line limit for hand-written documents.

summary.description: One line of text. `TODO` marks a draft and is reported as a warning.

provider.description: `child.capability`, or, for a need of a child, a need of this unit (bare name) that this unit does not meet inside. A connection joins two units; a folder is never a provider.

kind.description: Free text for the technical nature, for example library, http, events, cli.

parts.description: The parts of the contract this side uses: the `###` headings under `## Parts`, or the files of a contract folder.

contract.description: The contract of the connection: a path, relative to the folder of the manifest, to a Markdown file in docs/references/ of this unit or of an ancestor, or a mapping with `path` and `parts`. Not a URL. Both sides of a connection name the same document.

kind.description: Free text for the technical nature.

parts.description: The parts of the contract this side uses: the `###` headings under `## Parts`, or the files of a contract folder.

contract.description: The contract of the connection: a path, relative to the folder of the manifest, to a Markdown file in docs/references/ of this unit or of an ancestor, or a mapping with `path` and `parts`. Not a URL. Both sides of a connection name the same document.

optional.description: true if the need may stay unconnected.

platform.description: On a need of the root only: true marks a service of the host such as time or randomness, with a controllable fake. The adapter rule does not apply to it.

source.description: Free text: where the story comes from.

hops.description: `caller -> target.part`: units by their path from this unit, a capability or need of this unit bare.
